label: Bible Study
prompt: Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new _____: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.
verse: Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.
note: 'Creature' is KJV for 'creation' — brand new, with the old things gone.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: He shall feed his flock like a _____: he shall gather the lambs with his arm, and carry them in his bosom, and shall gently lead those that are with young.
verse: He shall feed his flock like a shepherd: he shall gather the lambs with his arm, and carry them in his bosom, and shall gently lead those that are with young.
note: Lambs carried in his bosom, mothers gently led — Isaiah's shepherd runs a tender operation.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Then spake Joshua to the LORD in the day when the LORD delivered up the Amorites before the children of Israel, and he said in the sight of Israel, Sun, stand thou _____ upon Gibeon; and thou, Moon, in the valley of Ajalon.
verse: Then spake Joshua to the LORD in the day when the LORD delivered up the Amorites before the children of Israel, and he said in the sight of Israel, Sun, stand thou still upon Gibeon; and thou, Moon, in the valley of Ajalon.
note: Joshua's audacious battlefield prayer: 'Sun, stand thou still' — and the sun took orders.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Do all things without _____ and disputings:
verse: Do all things without murmurings and disputings:
note: Paul's shortest hard command — 'murmurings' is the grumble Israel perfected in the wilderness.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: But the natural man receiveth not the things of the Spirit of God: for they are foolishness unto him: neither can he know them, because they are spiritually _____.
verse: But the natural man receiveth not the things of the Spirit of God: for they are foolishness unto him: neither can he know them, because they are spiritually discerned.
note: The natural man can't grade spiritual things — they are 'spiritually discerned,' says Paul.
